propositions: Deprecated 'Success Criteria' vocabulary must be removed from live prose and replaced with 'Acceptance Criteria' in src/rebar/llm/completion.py, tests/interfaces/store/test_completion_verifier.py, and docs/sample-ticket-log.jsonl

A repository guard (check_criteria_vocabulary.py) must scan for residual or reintroduced Success Criteria matches with count-pinned allowlist exemptions for four permanent semantic carve-outs, migration artifacts, and frozen fixtures
The guard must validate allowlist integrity (malformed fields, duplicate paths, count drift, absent paths) and fail on any unaccounted matches outside documented exclusions
The guard must be wired into the root Makefile lint target so local and CI runs enforce the policy deterministically

Scoped bare-token rule must match 'SC' or 'SCs' only within src/rebar/llm/reviewers/, src/rebar/_guides/, .rebar/criteria_routing.json, and generated plan-review-criteria-guide.md; bare tokens elsewhere are exempt
Full test coverage must prove phrase detection, bare-token scoping, allowlist parsing, count validation, and end-to-end lint failure on injection while the clean checkout passes
